limits: Single matched sample for each phase and provider; job times include setup, caches, workload, evidence and cleanup.
Cold means fresh logical tags in a shared workspace, with prior content eligible for deduplication.
BoringCache retains complete typed targets; Swatinem prunes target contents, including test executables. Entry byte sums are not equivalent physical-storage scopes.
Native sccache 0.17.0 lacks automatic cross-worktree Rust reuse; this test does not establish local-machine reuse.
The first complete run 34321522176 was excluded from the final speed table because some GitHub warm keys changed with preinstalled runner toolchains.
